about: Where each emoji's eyes are, so covers line them up with the person's eyes (track.eye_place). eye_y: the eye line as a fraction of the emoji picture's height (track.emoji_sprite: cropped to its ink, top 0, bottom 1), measured by eye on ruled sheets of the Apple Color Emoji glyphs (2026-11-14). Asymmetric eyes (🤪) use the middle of the two. Emoji without eyes (food, 🦋, 🐙) aren't listed and are drawn centred as before.
reference_about: Where real eyes sit in a face cover box, from its centre in box sizes (negative = above): SCRFD's eye landmarks on 888 jazz covers (measured in the SCRFD era; the scan now uses RetinaFace, not re-measured), median -0.025 (quartiles -0.040, -0.010).
